title: Audience Match Rate Basis
description: Where an audience match rate came from. Qualifies effective_match_rate on a sync_audiences result so a buyer can tell a rate the platform reported from one computed from approximate counts.

enumDescriptions.platform_reported: The destination platform reported the match rate itself. The seller passes it through without recomputing it.
enumDescriptions.derived: The seller computed the match rate from other counts it holds, for example a size or matched count divided by the number of members uploaded. When any input is approximate or bucketed the rate is itself approximate.
